scientific_intent.scientific_task: Sum selected expert outputs for each token feature.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: output[token,feature]=sum(expert=1..3) input[token,expert,feature]; no routing weights in this kernel.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: 512 tokens,3 experts,1024 hidden features; scalar andvec4 cases.
invariants: Each output contains exactly three expert terms.
accuracy_requirements: All524288 Float32 values absolute1e-4 dual-reference/CPU verified.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float32 short reduction order; packed vectorization affects code shape not mathematical formula.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: topK3 only; topK2/4 original cases unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Mixture-of-experts tensor aggregation; source names num_tokens/topk/hidden_size, not a particular scientific model.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: No gating, weighted routing, expert computation or end-to-end neural inference included.
